scope: One user-authorized mobile-copy short link; redirect-shape probe followed by a redacted parse through the rebuilt local API.
security_controls: Redirects disabled in the HTTP client and followed manually.
Every hop resolved separately and required only public-unicast answers.
Each connection used CurlOpt.RESOLVE with the vetted address set.
TLS certificate and hostname verification remained enabled.
The existing three-redirect and total-deadline limits remained active.
limitations: This single sample establishes only the observed host/path and redirect shape.
It does not establish availability for every short token, VPS egress, or caller network.
Media file-header checks, full downloads, and playback were not part of this probe.
